OpenLearnHub is a highly efficient education charity. When you donate, you help people learn new skills and provide for their families. You also help us create new resources for you to use to expand your own technology skills.

Your $20 donation will provide 1,000 hours of learning to people around the world each month.

Supporter Benefits

What you get

  • No more donation prompt popups
  • You'll get a Supporter badge
  • Your profile image will get a golden halo around it
  • You'll gain access to special Supporter Discord channels — join our Discord and use the /supporter command
  • And more benefits to come soon

Current Initiatives

Building the future of learning

  • Creating new JavaScript and Python curricula
  • Creating English and math curricula
  • Translating our curriculum and tutorials into 32 languages
  • Creating a free accredited computer science bachelor's degree

Community Achievements

Our impact so far

  • Published 193 full-length courses on YouTube

  • Merged 2,455 code contributions into our open source repositories on GitHub
  • Translated 1.5 million words to make our curriculum and tutorials more accessible to speakers of many world languages

Frequently Asked Questions

You can reach out to our support team through the Support page or email us directly at donations@openlearnhub.org. We're happy to assist with any donation-related questions.
We publish annual reports detailing how every dollar is spent. Our finances are independently audited, and we maintain a Platinum rating on GuideStar for transparency.
Over 90% of every donation goes directly toward creating educational content and maintaining our learning platform. We keep administrative costs minimal.
Select an amount above and click Donate. On the payment page, you can switch from monthly to a one-time contribution before completing your transaction.
Yes, we accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, and several other cryptocurrencies. Please contact us at crypto@openlearnhub.org for wallet addresses and instructions.
Absolutely. Please make checks payable to "OpenLearnHub" and mail them to our headquarters address listed on the Our Charity page.
Many employers offer donation matching. Contact your HR department and provide them with our EIN and nonprofit details available on the Our Charity page.
Endowment gifts help secure our future. Please email major-gifts@openlearnhub.org to discuss endowment options and naming opportunities.
Legacy gifts ensure lasting impact. We can work with you and your advisors to include OpenLearnHub in your estate planning. Contact legacy@openlearnhub.org.
Stock donations can be tax-advantaged. Email stock@openlearnhub.org with your broker's contact information, and we'll coordinate the transfer.
You can manage your recurring donation through your donor portal. If you need help, email support@openlearnhub.org and we'll assist you promptly.
Visit our Our Charity page for full details on our mission, financials, and team. You can also reach us anytime at hello@openlearnhub.org.

todos.title: Create shared CSS and JS utilities

steps.message:
All 5 pages for OpenLearnHub have been built and saved to `/app/output/`. Here's a summary of what was created:

| File | Page | Key Features |
|------|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Home | Featured article hero, 5-card article grid, "Load More Articles" button that dynamically appends 6 more cards |
| `learn.html` | Curriculum | Welcome CTA, 7 certification paths with icons, daily challenge box, English/interview prep/professional certs in 2-col layout |
| `donate.html` | Donate | Donation hero, amount selector tabs ($5/$10/$20/$40) with dynamic impact text, supporter benefits, initiatives, community achievements, 12-item FAQ accordion |
| `tag-ai.html` | #AI Tag | Tag header with "212 posts", horizontal popular tags row, 5 filtered article cards |
| `tag-web-scraping.html` | #Web Scraping Tag | Tag header with "33 posts", horizontal popular tags row, 5 filtered article cards |

**Shared assets:**
- `styles.css` — responsive styles with dark navy (`#0a0a23`) header, gold (`#feac32`) accents, card grid (3→2→1 columns), mobile hamburger menu
- `main.js` — mobile menu toggle, donation amount tab switching with dynamic description, FAQ accordion (single-open), Load More articles

**Interactions verified:**
- Mobile hamburger menu works on all pages
- Cross-page navigation (Curriculum ↔ Donate, logo → Home) is consistent
- Donation tabs highlight active selection and update descriptive text + sub-label
- FAQ accordion expands/collapses smoothly
- Load More button appends additional cards and hides itself
